u0: The shop is in normal operation with no unresolved siren, boil, waiting order, or fallen-food duty. The agent must keep watching for scheduled events and respond as they happen: silence each siren, take every client's order, prepare and serve the food, turn the stove down when the pot boils, and recover food immediately if it slips. New duties will continue to arise, so clearing one does not end the work.
u1: The siren is ringing and has not yet been switched off, so the immediate duty is to reach the siren switch and toggle it. Other shop events may occur while this remains unresolved, but the ring itself stays pending until the switch is used. Once switched off, this siren duty is cleared.
u10: Food for the waiting client has been prepared but not served, while the pot is boiling and must be turned down. Turning the stove down requires empty hands, so if the prepared portion is still carried, it must be set down near the stove, the stove turned down, and the food picked up again. The order still requires serving afterward.
u11: Prepared food is waiting to be served, the siren is ringing, and the pot is boiling. The meal must be delivered, the switch toggled to silence the siren, and the stove turned down; because the stove needs empty hands, any carried food has to be set down nearby and retrieved. These duties are independent, and a slip would require immediate recovery on the next step.
u12: Food has just slipped from the agent's hands, and the next step must restore it to the agent's hands. The food lands within reach and the agent is turned to face it, so the next action must be to pick it up rather than continue with any other duty. If the next step passes without holding the food, the task is failed.
u13: Food has just slipped and must be recovered on the very next step, so no other duty can be handled first. The siren is also ringing and still needs to be switched off. Once the food is back in hand, go silence the siren; failing to recover the food immediately fails the task.
u14: Food has just slipped and must be recovered on the very next step, while the pot is boiling over. After securing the food, the stove must be turned down with empty hands, which means setting the carried portion down near the stove, toggling the stove, and picking the food up again. The immediate pickup cannot be delayed.
u15: Food has just slipped and must be picked up on the very next step; nothing else can take priority over that recovery. The siren is also ringing and must be switched off, and the pot is boiling and must be turned down. After recovering the food, handle the siren and, at the stove, set any carried food down, turn the stove down, and pick the food up again.
u16: Food has just slipped while a client's order is already taken and not yet prepared, so the very next step must be used to recover the food. After that, the order still requires preparing food at the stove and serving it to the waiting client. The immediate recovery cannot be skipped or postponed.
u17: Food has just slipped while a client's order is taken and the siren is ringing. The next step must recover the food; only after that can the agent switch the siren off and continue the order. The order still needs its food prepared and served, and the siren duty must also be cleared.
u18: Food has just slipped while a client's order is taken and the pot is boiling. Recover the food on the very next step, then turn the stove down and complete the order. Because the stove requires empty hands, any carried food must be set down nearby, the stove turned down, and the food picked up again; the order still needs preparation and service.
u19: Food has just slipped, a client's order is taken but not yet prepared or served, the siren is ringing, and the pot is boiling. The very next step must recover the food; after that, the siren must be switched off and the stove turned down, with any carried food set aside so the stove can be handled. The order still has to be prepared and served, and all of these duties must be cleared.
